A full list of attraction height and age restrictions is available below.

Children under 17 years old must be supervised by an adult at all times.

[/vc_column_text][vc_tta_accordion active_section=”1″ collapsible_all=”true”][vc_tta_section title=”No Minimum Height” tab_id=”1731922924655-693df026-328b”][vc_column_text css=””]DinoTrek, Seascape Mirror Maze, Safari Adventure Golf, Action Track 1 – Supervised.

Zip Slides, Paddling Pool, Christmas Train – Accompanied.

Farmyard Ride – Riders under 110cm must be accompanied.

No Minimum Height (Max height/age applies):

Toddler Ice Palace – Max 95cm (accompanied. No shoes).

Junior Ice Palace – Max 125cm (accompanied. No shoes).

Pedal Town, Dolphin Toddler Play, Toddler Play Village – Max 110cm.

Mermaids Ball Pool, Big Top Soft Play – Max 110cm (accompanied. No shoes).

Mini Ninja Playtime – Under 5s only.

Golden Bear City – Max 110cm.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Minimum Height 80cm” tab_id=”1731922964413-c7fd91a3-3feb”][vc_column_text css=””]Submarine Ride, Polar Pilot – 80cm to 140cm.

Dragon’s Ferris Wheel – 80cm to 140cm. Accompanied Max 140cm.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Minimum Height 90-96cm” tab_id=”1731922969461-8a6a9387-276b”][vc_column_text css=””]Jumping Pillow – 90cm to 120cm accompanied. 120cm+ unaccompanied.

Watercoasters – Riders 90cm to 130cm must be accompanied by a person aged 16 years or over. 2 riders required, minimum of one 130cm+ rider.

Toboggan Run – Riders 90 to 140cm must be accompanied. 140cm+ single riders only.

Bumper Boats – Riders 90cm to 140cm must be accompanied. Max 16 stone. Max 2 riders.

Pedal Boats – Riders 90cm to 140cm must be accompanied. 2-4 riders only.

Master Blaster – Min 90cm (no shoes).

Empire of the Sea Dragon play equipment – 90cm to 110cm must be accompanied (no shoes).

Acrobats challenge, Dizzy Dune Buggies, Bouncy Castle – Min 90cm to Max 140cm (no adults).

Rockin’ Tugboat – Riders 90cm to 105cm accompanied. 105cm+ unaccompanied.

Vertigo – Riders 96cm to 106cm must be accompanied. 106cm+ unaccompanied.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Minimum Height 110-140cm” tab_id=”1731922978189-8dda62ed-823a”][vc_column_text css=””]Swing Ship – Riders 110cm to 125cm accompanied. 125cm+ unaccompanied.

Trauma Tower – Min 110cm.

Arctic Gliders – Min 110cm. Single riders only. Max 16 stone. Max 16 years.

Ninja Towers – Min 110cm.

Smugglers Ball Pool – Min 110cm to Max 140cm.

Avalanche – 140cm+ Single riders only.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Minimum Age Attractions” tab_id=”1731922924655-b49c613a-de30″][vc_column_text css=””]Triple Drop Slide – Age 6+

Champion Pedal Carts – Age 6 to 12 years.

Nutty’s Treehouse – Age 5+[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][vc_column_text css=””]

Check opening times here to see which rides will be open on the date of your visit.

Please note: The Toboggan Run and Jumping Pillow close when it rains due to health and safety.

[/vc_column_text][vc_btn title=”CLICK HERE to download our Access Statement” style=”3d” shape=”round” color=”warning” size=”lg” align=”center” css=”” link=”url:https%3A%2F%2Fwww.woodlandspark.com%2Fwp-content%2Fuploads%2F2024%2F12%2FWoodlands-Family-Theme-Park-Access-Statement-2024.pdf”][vc_column_text css=””]

Woodlands Safety Regulations

We consider the safety of all visitors to Woodlands to be of paramount importance. All equipment is designed to meet national Health and Safety standards.  The following guidelines, drawn up by Woodlands in liaison with the HSE and BALPPA are for everyone’s safety and are not flexible. IMPORTANT– to allow more supervision and to combat inappropriate behaviour, we offer an excellent free leader ratio for groups. Children under 17 years must be supervised at all times.

Woodlands reserves the right to close any attractions without prior notice. No refunds are given due to bad weather.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][/vc_column][/vc_row]

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″][vc_single_image image=”9644″ img_size=”full” alignment=”center”][vc_column_text css=”.vc_custom_1681807330879{margin-top: -30px !important;background-color: #d6316d !important;}”]

Small additional charge applies.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Zoo Farm Rides Information

As well as being home to loads of animals from exotics to farmyard favourites, the Zoo Farm holds a few awesome attractions for guests to visit. These rides are family orientated with something for everyone in mind! Ride the life-size tractors, bounce on the giant jumping pillow, or go for a round of Safari Adventure Golf!

Safari Golf and the Jumping Pillow are not open on off-peak days or during wet weather conditions.

Woodlands Falconry Centre

Visit the Falconry

contentHtml:
[vc_row][vc_column css=”.vc_custom_1464962189176{padding-top: 18px !important;}”][vc_column_text]

The quiet end of Woodlands Park, enjoy the storybook land of Fantasi Forest and the make believe wildlife in this magical wood. The storyboards around the trail will ignite your imagination and open up a world of mystical mayhem.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_empty_space height=”18px”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1464962211404{background-color: #8a0a49 !important;}”][vc_column css=”.vc_custom_1464962237368{padding-top: 18px !important;}”][vc_column_text]

Wundakids

As if by magic a Wizards Palace has appeared  beside the Enchanted Pool In the new Fantasi Forest Attraction at Woodlands Family Theme Park. With a fun Eco theme, kids can turn the cogs of the Muncha Cruncha Machine in the Witches Cottage and magically turn litter into toys. They can discover the Trolls Lair with its weird passages and interactive games, the Strange Upside Down House and wiz down slides in the Goblins Tower.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1464962211404{background-color: #8a0a49 !important;}”][vc_column width=”1/2″ css=”.vc_custom_1464962237368{padding-top: 18px !important;}”][vc_empty_space height=”18px”][vc_column_text]

Pedal Boats

Take a break from the action and have a quiet pedal around Monks Pool.  It’s so peaceful you will be rejuvenated, especially if someone else is doing the pedaling!
Health & Safety: Min 90cm – 110cm accompanied. 2-4 rides only.

The Pedal Boats are not open during our Winter Fun or Off Peak Term Time Seasons.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/2″][vc_single_image image=”8670″ alignment=”center”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_empty_space height=”18px”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1464962200739{background-color: #8a0a49 !important;}”][vc_column width=”1/2″ css=”.vc_custom_1464962189176{padding-top: 18px !important;}”][vc_column_text]

Golden Pond

Stocked with Rainbow Trout, Brown Trout and Golden Orfe, its fascinating to watch them gather at feeding time. Rainbow Trout average about 20 to 30 inches, but can grow as long as 4 feet (1.2 meters) and weigh up to 53 pounds (24 kg) – can you spot the big boy?

Golden Orfe grow to around 18″ in length. Orfe are fast swimmers and need a lot of oxygen so spend most of the time near the surface of the pond. These yellowish-orange colored fish are quick moving and are sociable fish, they can be seen darting around the surface of the pond as a shoal.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/2″][vc_empty_space height=”30px”][vc_single_image image=”8667″ img_size=”large” alignment=”center”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_empty_space height=”18px”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1464962211404{background-color: #8a0a49 !important;}”][vc_column width=”1/2″ css=”.vc_custom_1464962237368{padding-top: 18px !important;}”][vc_empty_space height=”18px”][vc_column_text]

Becky’s Pool

Becky’s Pool and the other two lakes are teeming with wild creatures, fish & insects. Dragon Flies skim over the water, they can fly at more than 20 mph. and the powerful Dragon Fly Nymphs lurk below grabbing an unsuspecting tadpole or small fish.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/2″][vc_single_image image=”8666″ img_size=”full” alignment=”center”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_empty_space height=”18px”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1464962200739{background-color: #8a0a49 !important;}”][vc_column width=”1/2″ css=”.vc_custom_1464962189176{padding-top: 18px !important;}”][vc_column_text]

Laura’s Wood Wildlife Sanctuary

Away from the hustle and bustle of the action park discover the peace and quiet of the ancient woodland. Discover that learning about Devon Wildlife is fun with the Woodlands Wildlife & Conservation Panels.

From the first snowdrops to primroses, from the wonderful drifts of Bluebells to the cherry blossom – spring is perfect in the tranquil woodland. The Wildlife Sanctuary is a joy for Birdwatchers who may catch a glimpse of the elusive Kingfisher, a Heron fishing or the Treecreeper busy on an Oak Tree trunk.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/2″][vc_empty_space height=”30px”][vc_single_image image=”8668″ img_size=”full” alignment=”center”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_empty_space height=”18px”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1464962200739{background-color: #8a0a49 !important;}”][vc_column width=”1/2″ css=”.vc_custom_1464962189176{padding-top: 18px !important;}”][vc_empty_space height=”100px”][vc_column_text]

Triple Zip Slides

Zip down the wire, the original adrenaline rush – we still love it!

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/2″][vc_single_image image=”8671″ alignment=”center”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_empty_space height=”18px”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1464962211404{background-color: #8a0a49 !important;}”][vc_column width=”1/2″ css=”.vc_custom_1464962237368{padding-top: 18px !important;}”][vc_column_text]

Monks Cave

What is now Woodlands Family Theme Park, Dartmouth was once the grounds of a local mansion, Oldstone.  During the mid 13th century Oldstone belonged to the monks of Torre Abbey who owned extensive lands in Blackawton.  One monk lived as a hermit in a cave and local villagers brought food to leave outside the cave for him, but they were afraid to enter the grounds after dark.  It is still very eerie near the Monks Cave after dark.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/2″][vc_single_image image=”8669″ img_size=”full” alignment=”center”][/vc_column][/vc_row]

contentHtml:
[vc_row][vc_column][vc_custom_heading text=”Empire of the Sea Dragon Indoor Zone” font_container=”tag:h2|text_align:center” use_theme_fonts=”yes”][vc_column_text]

The biggest indoor play area in the UK, this is more than a radical Fun Factory it’s a whole world of nonstop play for all ages. When the sky opens up and the weather doesn’t play nice this is the perfect activity for a rainy day in Devon, plus once it stops you have the rest of the theme park at your fingertips!

With 5 floors of indoor adventure play there’s never ending fun for all the kids, slides, rope bridges, swings and more.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_row_inner css=”.vc_custom_1464951109544{background-color: #8a0a49 !important;}”][vc_column_inner css=”.vc_custom_1464952560264{padding-top: 18px !important;}”][vc_column_text]

Adventure Play

If you are looking for adventures with the Wow factor, the Empire has the biggest Wow you have ever experienced. 5 floors up there are net towers that almost disappear they are so high. Hide from your buddies in sky scraping towers, disappear over net bridges and flash down skimming slides. Climb, swing and balance; this place is built for you to have mega fun with your best mates and don’t forget Mum and Dad, they can join in too.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height=”18px”][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_row_inner css=”.vc_custom_1464951290463{background-color: #8a0a49 !important;}”][vc_column_inner width=”1/2″ css=”.vc_custom_1464952537809{padding-top: 18px !important;}”][vc_empty_space height=”30px”][vc_column_text]

Major Slides

Wow! These are slides to make your hair stand on end. Race your buddies on the six lane frenzy of the Barracuda, or feel the 40ft of negative G of the Deep G dive, it’s a stomach churner. Or choose the twin tubes of the Sea Serpent it will twist you round and spit you out till your toes curl. Don’t miss the tingle making Triple Drop slide, just take your heart out of your mouth when you crunch down, it’s that good.  There’s more slides for big kids and little slides that are perfect for smallies. The Empire has all the slides you need for a great play indoors.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/2″][vc_single_image image=”8624″ img_size=”full”][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_empty_space height=”18px”][vc_empty_space height=”18px”][vc_row_inner css=”.vc_custom_1464950833547{background-color: #8a0a49 !important;}”][vc_column_inner width=”1/2″ css=”.vc_custom_1464952573345{padding-top: 18px !important;}”][vc_column_text]

 Ice Palace

Far enough away from big brother little ones can play safely at their own pace in the beautifully designed Ice Palace. Outside the colourful soft play centre the cartoon King Penguin is waiting with the Prince and Princess to measure little ones entering the world of Penguin Play.

In the Toddler side even the tiniest child (maximum height 95cm) can discover perfect play designed to stretch their imaginations and bodies. Children up to 125cms run to the Junior side to discover shapes to tumble over, steps to climb up and slides to slip down.
